settings.headline: Every unit tested, every test kept
settings.subtitle: Each valve is pressure-tested and each pump runs on a test loop before it ships. The records are tied to the serial number on the tag.

settings.headline: From bar stock to shipping dock
settings.intro: What happens to a Series 140 ball valve at Brask Ford.

items.title: Material receipt
items.text: Bar stock is checked against its mill certificate and the heat number is recorded.

items.title: Machining
items.text: First-article inspection on every new setup; in-process gauging every 25 parts.

items.title: Assembly
items.text: Seats, seals and stem packing installed to a torque record.

items.title: Shell and seat test
items.text: Shell at 1.5 × rated pressure; seat test to API 598.

items.title: Tag and archive
items.text: Serial number on the tag links to the material and test record for 25 years.

settings.headline: Certificates
settings.body: All three plants are certified to ISO 9001:2015. Brask Ford and Linnmoor are also certified to ISO 14001, and Linnmoor to ISO 45001. Product approvals are listed on each product page.
settings.aside: Call inside sales with the serial number on the tag. Records are sent by email the same day (story).
